questions.source_content:
ADMINISTRATIVE CIRCULAR
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Sawai Madhopur
Date: 26 September 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/206)
Subject: Annual Door-to-Door Verification Camp for Social Security Pension Beneficiaries (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Sawai Madhopur division are hereby informed that under 'Annual Door-to-Door Verification Camp for Social Security Pension Beneficiaries', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 11 September in the central nodal wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #306) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Sawai Madhopur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and nodal movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Sawai Madhopur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #116, 3. Digital Indexing.
District Supply Officer
Dr. Suresh Chandra Choudhary
solution_steps: 1. Click inside the Second Paragraph.
2. Set Spacing After to '6 pt' and Line Spacing to '1.15'.
